source_text: וּ/נְשָׂאתֶ֗ם אֵ֚ת סִכּ֣וּת מַלְכְּ/כֶ֔ם וְ/אֵ֖ת כִּיּ֣וּן צַלְמֵי/כֶ֑ם כּוֹכַב֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵי/כֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר עֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם לָ/כֶֽם׃
english_snapshot: And you carried Sikkuth your king[a], and Kiyyun your images, the star of your god[c][b], which you made for yourselves.

signals.text: Or possibly 'the star of your gods,' though the Masoretic pointing supports the singular 'your god.'

source_text: לְמַ֨עַן יִֽירְשׁ֜וּ אֶת שְׁאֵרִ֤ית אֱדוֹם֙ וְ/כָל הַ/גּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר נִקְרָ֥א שְׁמִ֖/י עֲלֵי/הֶ֑ם נְאֻם יְהוָ֖ה עֹ֥שֶׂה זֹּֽאת־־־־׃פ
english_snapshot: so that they may possess the remnant of Edom and all the nations who are called by my name,” declares Yahweh[b][a], who does this.

signals.text: The Greek form of this verse cited in Acts 15:17 differs notably, reading along the lines of “so that the remnant of mankind may seek the Lord, and all the nations upon whom my name has been called.”
